focus_anchor: current focus openai codex provider support
why_now:
even after the installer copies the six skill
markdowns into `~/.codex/plugins/autocc/skills/`, a Codex
session loading them still cannot find the autopilot flag or
the task board because the skill bodies read the wrong env
var — the install path will appear to succeed and then the
loop will fail on the first turn. Decoupling the env-var
contract is the last piece needed for an end-to-end Codex
autopilot run.
